fields.name: Tokyo
fields.description: A hyper-modern metropolis blending neon skyscrapers with historic Shinto shrines.

fields.name: Kyoto
fields.description: The cultural heart of Japan, famous for thousands of classical Buddhist temples and pristine zen gardens.

fields.name: New Delhi
fields.description: A bustling capital city steeped in history, featuring massive fortresses, bustling markets, and grand monuments.

fields.name: Mumbai
fields.description: A dynamic financial hub and heart of the Bollywood film industry, located right on the Arabian Sea coast.

fields.name: Seoul
fields.description: A high-tech capital where modern skyscrapers and pop culture meet historic palaces and street markets.

fields.name: Busan
fields.description: A scenic coastal city known for its expansive beaches, seafood markets, and beautiful mountain temples.

fields.name: Bangkok
fields.description: A vibrant capital renowned for ornate shrines, intense street life, and dynamic floating markets.

fields.name: Chiang Mai
fields.description: A mountainous city in northern Thailand, famous for its historic Old City walls and misty rainforest sanctuaries.

fields.name: Paris
fields.description: A global center for art, fashion, gastronomy, and world-famous cafe culture.

fields.name: Nice
fields.description: A beautiful coastal city on the French Riviera, known for its pebble beaches and sunny Mediterranean climate.

fields.name: London
fields.description: The historic capital of the UK, boasting iconic sites like Big Ben, the Tower of London, and world-class museums.

fields.name: Edinburgh
fields.description: Scotland's compact, hilly capital, featuring a historic medieval Old Town and a striking clifftop castle.

fields.name: Rome
fields.description: A sprawling cosmopolitan city with nearly 3,000 years of globally influential art, architecture, and culture.

fields.name: Florence
fields.description: The cradle of the Renaissance, famous for iconic masterpieces of art and brilliant red-domed architecture.

fields.name: Madrid
fields.description: Spain's central capital, known for elegant boulevards, expansive parks, and rich repositories of European art.

fields.name: Barcelona
fields.description: The seaside capital of Catalonia, celebrated globally for its whimsical Antoni Gaudí architecture.

fields.name: New York City
fields.description: The Big Apple, featuring iconic landmarks like Times Square, Central Park, and the Broadway theater district.

fields.name: Los Angeles
fields.description: The entertainment capital of the world, home to Hollywood, sandy beaches, and sprawling urban landscapes.

fields.name: Toronto
fields.description: A dynamic Canadian metropolis with a soaring skyline punctuated by the iconic CN Tower.

fields.name: Vancouver
fields.description: A bustling west coast seaport surrounded by majestic mountains, popular for filming and outdoor sports.

fields.name: Mexico City
fields.description: The high-altitude capital city famous for Aztec ruins, colonial design, and a booming culinary scene.

fields.name: Cancun
fields.description: A world-famous resort destination bordered by the beautiful turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea.

fields.name: Rio de Janeiro
fields.description: A seaside city framed by Copacabana beach and the towering Christ the Redeemer statue.

fields.name: Sao Paulo
fields.description: A massive, sprawling financial center ranked among the world's most populous modern cities.

fields.name: Buenos Aires
fields.description: Argentina's cosmopolitan capital city, famous for European architecture, tango dancing, and rich steakhouses.

fields.name: Bariloche
fields.description: A beautiful town nestled in the Andes mountains, famous for Swiss-like architecture and alpine ski slopes.

fields.name: Lima
fields.description: The historic capital of Peru, located on the arid Pacific coast and renowned as South America's food capital.

fields.name: Cusco
fields.description: A city high up in the Andes mountains that once served as the historic capital of the ancient Incan Empire.

fields.name: Bogota
fields.description: A high-altitude capital city featuring cobblestone colonial paths alongside striking high-rises.

fields.name: Medellin
fields.description: Nicknamed the City of Eternal Spring, framed by a gorgeous mountain valley and modern cable car systems.

fields.name: Cape Town
fields.description: A breathtaking port city uniquely positioned beneath the dramatic, flat top of Table Mountain.

fields.name: Johannesburg
fields.description: South Africa's large urban economic powerhouse, deeply rooted in history, gold rush heritage, and street art.

fields.name: Cairo
fields.description: Egypt's historic capital on the Nile River, famously home to the Giza Pyramids and complex street labyrinths.

fields.name: Luxor
fields.description: An ancient open-air monument valley featuring the spectacular Valley of the Kings and Karnak temples.

fields.name: Nairobi
fields.description: Kenya's capital city, globally unique for having a full-scale game reserve park right outside its skyscrapers.

fields.name: Mombasa
fields.description: A historic tropical island city on the Indian Ocean coast, blending African, Arabic, and Portuguese architecture.

fields.name: Marrakech
fields.description: A historical economic hub featuring palace remnants, intricate souk markets, and vibrant city squares.

fields.name: Casablanca
fields.description: A modern commercial port city showcasing French colonial history combined with traditional Moorish architecture.

fields.name: Sydney
fields.description: Famous for its world-class Opera House, massive steel Harbour Bridge, and pristine surf coast sand bays.

fields.name: Melbourne
fields.description: Australia's vibrant cultural capital, heavily celebrated for street art laneways and coffee house culture.

fields.name: Auckland
fields.description: A major urban center in the North Island based around two massive harbors and extinct volcanic peaks.

fields.name: Queenstown
fields.description: The adventure tourism capital of the South Island, framed beautifully by dramatic lake and mountain scenery.

fields.name: Suva
fields.description: The bustling island capital city of Fiji, showing off grand colonial-era architecture and rich local food markets.

fields.name: Nadi
fields.description: A warm transit port hub on the main island, serving as the main entry point to beautiful coral beaches and resorts.
